get.description: Returns paginated top-level comments with replies nested one level deep. Deleted comments show content '[deleted]' but are included so reply threads stay intact.

post.summary: Add a comment (or reply) to a post
post.description: Creates a top-level comment, or a reply when `parentId` is provided.

parentId.description: ID of the comment being replied to (omit for top-level)

400.description: Invalid input or parent comment not on this post

get.summary: Get comment count for a post
get.description: Lightweight count used for post cards in the feed. Does not count soft-deleted comments.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the comment (sets `isDeleted: true`, content becomes '[deleted]'). Only the comment author can delete. Replies are preserved.

403.description: Not authorised to delete this comment

post.description: One report per user per comment. A `409` is returned if the user already reported this comment.
Follow another user. Idempotent — calling again when already following returns 200 without error. Fires an in-app notification to the followed user.

parameters.name: targetId
parameters.description: ID of the user to follow

delete.description: Unfollow a user. Idempotent — safe to call even if not following.

get.description: Returns whether the authenticated user currently follows the target user, and when the follow started.
Returns posts from users the authenticated user follows, ordered newest first. Returns a helpful message when the user follows nobody yet.
Lists all users who follow the given user. Paginated, 30 per page.

get.summary: Get users that a user is following

followedAt.description: When the follow was created (present on follower/following list responses)

isDeleted.description: True if the author deleted it. Content becomes '[deleted]' but the node is kept so replies stay intact.

parentId.description: Null for top-level comments, set for replies

replies.description: Present only on top-level comments (one level deep)
